## About Me

Hello! I'm Nhi, a new grad student studying Mathematics, Data Science, and Chinese from St. Olaf College. I'm passionate about text and sentiment analysis and I currently have a big interest in transportation, specifically in aviation and metro system. My journey in data science has just begun and I'm very excited to see what's ahead!

Outside of academia, I collect a lot of Lego sets and my favorite themes are Architecture and Technic. I also like to travel abroad as well.

Explore around my website to learn more!
